explicitly_unresolved.reason: Source code cannot derive the per-run fingerprint preimage or bind any fingerprint to a candidate. None of the 12 observations is assigned by order, DOM path, fingerprint, or shape.

Each row's accessible text contains a locale-formatted timestamp, computed summary, and optional word count. These are dynamic; source supports the History control family EXT-F-1008-C05, but no stable exact label candidate exists.

Its title varies with mandateKey and its visible text includes dynamic agentName or a default-agent fallback. The visible value may be user/config dependent, so leave it unresolved absent a census-supported stable accessible-name rule; inventory family is EXT-F-1008-C11.

The static titles are source-owned, but their actual button accessible-name behavior is implemented in the shared component. A candidate can be bound only if the census captures the same title/text/aria source; otherwise the visible nested menu item labels (Summary (text), For AI agent, JSON) are separate menu state and require fresh source-backed observation.

The frozen receipt only gives 12 button fingerprints and unhelpful paths. The current source lists possible controls across several state-dependent branches; it does not prove which branches appeared in that run. No behavioral pass or complete mapping is claimed.
